summary: Iteration 3 bugfix verification (frontend only): ALL 4 fixed bugs verified PASS. (1) Sign-out: settings-signout-button opens in-app modal (settings-signout-modal); cancel dismisses and stays on Settings; confirm signs out and RouteGate redirects to /login. (2) Theme toggle: immediate full-app repaint (settings bg rgb(251,251,249)->rgb(18,18,18), dashboard repaints too), settings-theme-value flips Light/Dark, persists across page reload via 'aromaform_theme' hydration; left back on LIGHT as requested. (3) Share: formula-share-button no longer throws - inline formula-notice 'Sharing is not available in this browser — the formula was copied to your clipboard.' appears, zero page errors / no red overlay. (4) Back navigation: duplicate and new-version now router.push - back button returns to the original formula (formula_2db549afe2c3) with ZERO 'GO_BACK not handled' warnings; fresh deep-link to /formula/<id> in a new tab falls back to the tabs dashboard. Sanity: login, dashboard, IFRA red alert on Bergamot (1 warning row), calculator math (100g@18% -> 18.00g oil / 82.00g alcohol) all still PASS - no regressions.

Minor testability note (not a user bug): after router.push on web, both stack screens stay mounted in the DOM, so duplicate testIDs exist (hidden + visible). Tests must use :visible selectors. Consider this if E2E selectors ever become flaky.
No further fixes required - all iteration 2 bugs resolved. App ready to ship from a frontend perspective.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.ts useSyncExternalStore override store is the correct react-native-web-safe approach; boot hydration in _layout.tsx reads 'aromaform_theme' before first paint - verified working (dark theme survives reload).
settings.tsx RN Modal confirm is cross-platform safe (replaces Alert.alert no-op on web) - both cancel and confirm paths verified.
[id].tsx shareFormula try/catch + navigator.clipboard fallback works in a browser without navigator.share; transient notice auto-clears (4s timer) and no uncaught rejection.
Back button fallback (router.canGoBack() ? back() : replace('/(tabs)')) verified in both in-app push and fresh deep-link scenarios; no unhandled GO_BACK warnings remain.
Benign: two 401 console errors fired right after sign-out (in-flight react-query refetches without token) - no user impact, not a failure.
